tools.name: calendar
tools.description: Chinesecalendar for a date: lunar date (with leap month), zodiac, day officer 建除, yellow/black path, six-day cycle — computed on Beijing time

tools.name: ganzhi
tools.description: Four pillars (BaZi) for a date+hour, returned under BOTH year conventions (Lichun vs Lunar New Year) × BOTH day boundaries (midnight vs 23:00) — differences are shown, not hidden

tools.name: solar_terms
tools.description: All 24 solar terms of a year with exact Beijing instants (DE441-based), ΔT, and midnight-margin uncertainty flags

tools.name: kua_number
tools.description: Ming Gua (Kua number) from birth date + gender, with the Lichun year boundary computed astronomically, five-yellow substitution conventions, and eight favourable/unfavourable directions

tools.name: flying_star_chart
tools.description: Xuan Kong flying star natal chart: nine palaces with mountain/facing/period stars plus classical pattern labels (e.g. 旺山旺向). Period from a construction date, or explicit yun

tools.name: yun_period
tools.description: San Yuan period (三元九运, 1–9) for a date; periods switch at Lichun, anchored 1984 = start of Period 7

tools.name: rulesets
tools.description: List the rule sets the kernel actually implements, with parameters and honest review_state — nothing not implemented is advertised

tools.name: form_analysis
tools.description: Indoor form-sha from a floor-plan wireframe: 穿堂煞 (door-window alignment), 缺角 (nine-palace missing corners), 厕占中宫 (toilet at centre) — plus optional fusion with the Eight Mansions house stars and Ming Gua. Grade B verdicts, no aggregate score

tools.name: terrain_white_tiger
tools.description: White tiger elevation check (白虎抬头) from a DEM-derived 360-bin skyline: compares the right (white tiger) vs left (azure dragon) sector elevation within ±45° of the sitting direction

tools.name: replay
tools.description: Verifiability as an API call: recompute a stored request and compare its SHA-256 input digest (JCS-canonicalised) against an expected value — byte-identical reproduction or honest mismatch
